title: crataegus × media subsp. intermixta
intro: Crataegus × media subsp. intermixta, commonly known as Hawthorn, is a hybrid shrub or small tree species within the Rosaceae family. This plant is renowned for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Hawthorn are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, that have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Hawthorn, particularly quercetin, epicatechin, and vitexin, have been shown to exhibit protective effects against cardiovascular disease, neurodegenerative disorders, and other conditions, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
